title: Sergio Tachini continues serenading fans with new music, "Better Alone"
htmlContent:
Sergio Tachini is a multi-talented rapper and songwriter from Western Sydney, Australia. The talented star uses his music as a medium to tell us about his story of addiction, Heartbreak, and depression so that the upcoming generation can learn from it. Sergio Tachini continues serenading fans with new music, "Better Alone."

Sergio Tachini's "Better Alone" is a strong announcement about lifting from rock bottom and striving for more. The production of this song is fantastic, vocally, it's perfect, and the writing takes this song to the moon to make it a record you can't live without. "Better Alone" is the 5th track of his upcoming EP titled "Physically Here, Mentally Not."
